data.action: 坐在草地上，手捧家信与设计手记
data.description: 【澄闪 · 原野手记】维多利亚郊外微风和煦的青青草地上，苏茜盘腿坐在花丛中，怀里抱着家人的来信与自己精心绘制的发型设计手记。她转过身拉住你的衣角，眼神里满是憧憬与感激——「能在这里重新拿起剪刀、和大家一起平静地生活……对我来说真的就像奇迹一样幸福。」
data.promptProse: Goldenglow sits cross-legged in the breezy meadow outside Victoria, holding a family letter beside her hairstyle sketchbook and turning with a hopeful smile. Pink cable-patterned sweater, brown wool beret, pleated skirt and tights retain her autumn outfit, twintails near folded pink ears. The medium-wide view includes grass and scattered flowers extending behind. Bright afternoon light reveals paper edges and knit texture, leaving soft grass shadows beneath the seated pose.
data.title: 澄闪 · 原野手记
